briefdescription.para: Case entity for the clinics_visits table (a patient's visit to a clinic).

detaileddescription.para: This header declares the Visits class, a small C++ type that stands for one patient visit in the clinics_visits database table. Unlike the one-row-per-parent case tables, a visit has its own sequence-generated id as well as a patient_id and a clinic_id. The class itself holds no data; it names the table and leaves SQL generation to its parent Case. It also supplies small helper functions that build permission-checking SQL for create, read, update and delete operations.

WHY THIS FILE MATTERS IN THE SERVER: Visits is one of the clinic-owned "case" types exposed through the clinic routes as ClinicController<Visits> under the visits service type. When a client wants to add or change a visit, PermissionManager calls the static getPermissionsQueryFor* helpers here to build a SELECT that starts from the payload's patient_id, joins patients to find the owning clinic, then checks whether the requesting user is that clinic's owner, admin or staff. The visit id is also referenced by other case tables (paid services, prescriptions, requests, visit drugs). Without this file there would be no C++ type connecting the clinics_visits table to the CRUD and permission machinery.

CONCEPTS TO LEARN (for beginners):
static constexpr: a value fixed at compile time that belongs to the class, not to one object. https://en.cppreference.com/w/cpp/language/static
JSON: a text format used to carry request data; this project uses the jsoncons library to read it. https://jsoncons.github.io/jsoncons/
Sequence-generated id: a number the database produces automatically for each new row, used here as the visit's primary key. https://en.cppreference.com/w/cpp
